notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Gauntlets of Light attached to Krenko.
description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {2}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
